notes.title: Tweaks the deadzone for analog steering.
notes.notes: Your 86 has less of a chance of veering off into the abyss. You can't blame the controls anymore for crashing.

notes.title: Oh Snap, new track! Tsuchisaka Pass is now available!
notes.notes:
Tsuchisaka is located far west of Sadamine; and far northwest of Shomaru, Hanno; stretching between Kanna and Nishi Chichibu of the Gunma and Saitama prefectures.

Don't worry. All oil spills were cleaned up before release.

notes.title: Bunta tweaked a few things.
notes.notes: Old man can't seem to keep well enough alone. He says the 86 will feel better once you get used to it.

notes.title: Analog controls and D-Pad steering refinements.
notes.notes: Softer/less aggressive steering when not drifting.

notes.title: Refined analog stick controls.
notes.notes: Refinement of steering with the analog stick (stick drift taken into consideration at a higher sensitivity than the default Steam Deck settings).

notes.title: DORIFTUUUUU!!!! Bullet Time Mode
notes.notes:
If you're still having difficulty getting past the first turn, a ray of hope has arrived. When Training is enabled, you will be taken into Bullet Time. With the reduced speeds and a zoomed-in camera, you may be able to conquer your first mountain pass.

[previewyoutube=G_hOC28wEDk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Enhanced visuals. Edge to edge rendering.
notes.notes: Visuals and lighting got a small bump. You'll be able to see more of the track if you have a wide monitor. Max supported aspect ratio is 21:12. Seeing more of the track probably won't help you get past the first turn though.

notes.title: Co-op mode: Two players. One car.
notes.notes: Thought it would be fun for you to be able to control the 86 from any number of controllers. Grab a friend and have one person handle the steering and the other person controls the engagement of the drift :-)

notes.title: Training Mode for all the Itsukis out there.
notes.notes: Added a "training mode" option. You might actually make it past the first turn with this enabled Itsuki.

notes.title: Oh snap. New track!
notes.notes:
The track roster for A Car That Turns increases by one more track!

Happogahara has been released. The home course of the Todo School finds a place next to Akina, Usui, Myogi, and Iro Hazaka. Tight hairpins and ice rink corners will put your skills to the test.

Wait- have you even beaten Akina yet? You probably haven't even made it to the end without crashing huh? [i]sigh[/i]
